item.title: What I Learn from Working in Small Startup as A Fresh Graduate
item.description:
Hey , my name is Iman Syahputra Situmorang, a Fullstack Software Engineer in Bornevia.
I just start working for 6 months. A valuable 6 months to learn what is the feel when working in a small Start Up .

Well it will be a shocking news, about the closing of bornevia.com.
But I will not telling anything about the reason of bornevia’s closing, I’m just telling what I learn from Bornevia when I work over there.
